# new bragg PAM agreements: Trustly, CheckIn, Mindway AI and Mollie


October 12, 2026


bragg has signed new agreements with **Trustly** , **CheckIn.com** , **Mollie** and **Mindway AI** .


For operators, that means more choice in how they take deposits, verify players and support safer play, all through one player account management platform.


**Trustly: deposit and verification capabilities**
Trustly brings deposit and verification capabilities to bragg PAM, including Pay’n Play. With Pay’n Play, players verify their identity and make a deposit in a single step.


Pay’n Play is the primary sign-up and deposit method in Finland. As we prepare for the market’s regulated opening in 2027, operators planning for Finland can offer the player journey Finnish players already know.


**CheckIn.com: KYC and verification**
CheckIn.com has powered KYC and player verification on bragg PAM since 2021. It supports operators across regulated markets, where onboarding has to meet each market’s local requirements.


**Mindway AI: responsible gambling**


Mindway AI provides neuroscience, human expert and AI-based responsible gambling and player protection tools. Operators still contract with Mindway AI directly, but with the integration now in place, those using bragg PAM can get Mindway’s AI capabilities up and running faster.


**Mollie: flexible payment options**
Mollie brings local, flexible payments to the bragg PAM, giving operators more control over how players pay and get paid out.


Through the integration, operators can support both pay-ins and instant payouts, offer major (credit) card schemes, local payment methods across Europe, and Mollie’s recently launched Pay by Bank proposition, all through a single payment setup tailored to each market.


**More than a platform**
The right PAM is more than a platform. It’s the ecosystem behind it.


Each partner adds a capability operators can use through bragg PAM, without managing a separate integration. More partners, more capabilities, and more ways for operators to build the experience that works for their players.


To see how bragg PAM can support your markets,[get in touch with the team](https://bragg.group/#contact) !
